Companion Animal Travel Desk Procedures

This section states the required handling of companion animal travel records and service steps for Aurelia Skyways. The Companion Animal Travel Desk records each request in order, confirms the passenger's details, and routes any special care notes to the senior coordinator before service is approved. Staff must use the required booking form before any animal is accepted for travel. Passenger coordinators must give clear instructions to the traveler, note any carrier limits, and verify that the animal is fit for the planned journey. When arrival pickup needs escalation, the desk must pass the matter through the named extension and keep the record current until release is complete. Staff may coordinate with the traveler and the pet owner on documentation, but no change may be entered without review by the senior coordinator. Keep records complete, direct, and ready for audit.

Contact the senior coordinator or the passenger coordinator for any unresolved service issue.
